items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Dougie Williams? [INTERVIEWEE] That's an information that some piano players created on the piano.

ctx.x: Well, what are the players? The blues is called for feelings. It comes from hope on the slaves. You listen to the words. It's the feelings that the slaves got out of their bodies when they were either blue or happy. That's all the blues is.
That's an information that some piano players created on the piano.
